$schema.description: Where the JSON Schema for this file is, so an editor can complete and check it.

dailyUsd.description: Most spent on paid calls in one day, in US dollars. Default 5.

postUsd.description: Most spent on one post, in US dollars. Default 2.

caps.description: Spending limits, checked before every paid call.

provider.description: The provider that transcribes audio, e.g. "fal". Unset: the default.

model.description: One of the provider's models. Unset: the provider's default.

provider.description: The provider that makes the images, e.g. "fal". Unset: the default.

model.description: One of the provider's models. Unset: the provider's default.

cookiesFromBrowser.description: Browser whose login yt-dlp reuses, e.g. chrome. Instagram needs one. Unset: none.

font.description: Font family for burned-in captions. Default "Arial".

fontsDir.description: Folder with the font files, if it isn't installed.

fontSize.description: Caption size in pixels on the 1080×1920 frame.

highlight.description: Colour each word as it's spoken. Off by default (docs/research/captions.md).
